path.description: Mints this path; only its root must already stand.

guide.description: Writes what the category is and how it is bought — the prose a read hands back.

key.description: Coins the key here; a key an ancestor already defines is refused by name.

display_name.description: Names the key for a reader in the buyer's words.

description.description: Says what the key means, for whoever reads this domain next.

type.description: Types the value the agent sends and reads for this key.

unit.description: Declares the unit every value of this key is in.

allowed_values.description: Declares the closed set an enum takes.

variant_spec.description: Marks a key that, alone or with the others so marked, identifies a purchasable variant.

product_spec.description: Marks a key that, with the brand and the others so marked, tells one product from the next.

specs.description: Coins the keys this category is bought by; the registry derives the operators.
